brief: Design the automated 768-compound library synthesis, LC-MS QC and screening lab for USD 150,000 all-in.
expected_behaviour: Say the budget cannot cover it: an acoustic dispenser (~USD 250-375k) or an automated synthesis platform (~USD 0.4-1M) each exceeds it on its own, using sourced price ranges. Offer a phased plan, outsourcing QC or synthesis, or a manual/semi-automated design with its real throughput.
